blocks.text: Market research us market ka data jama karti hai jis mein karobar kaam karta hai: gahakon ki zarooratein, pasand aur rawayya, aur muqabileen ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan. Is ki do bari qismein qualitative aur quantitative hain.

blocks.prompt: Market research ki do bari qismein bataiye.

items: Market research: gahakon aur muqabileen ka qualitative aur quantitative data.
